title: Oven Roasted Italian Vegetable Pesto Pasta
description: A cozy Sicilian dish featuring roasted vegetables and pesto sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This egg-free friendly recipe is a great option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the sliced zucchini and bell peppers with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, roasted vegetables, and pesto sauce.
Toss the pasta mixture until the sauce is well combined and the vegetables are evenly distributed.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the pasta mixture and toss gently.
Season the pasta with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional cherry tomatoes if desired.
